paragraphs: Stitch Fix is the leading online personal styling service that helps people discover the styles they will love that fit perfectly so they always look - and feel - their best.

In 2011, Stitch Fix, Inc. ("we," "our," "us," "the Company," or "Stitch Fix") introduced an innovative approach to shopping for clothing and accessories. We were inspired by the opportunity to create a client-first styling experience, offering an alternative to impersonal, time-consuming and inconvenient traditional shopping.

Since inception, our business has been grounded in our commitment to developing and fostering client relationships and making people happier and more confident in what they wear. We help our clients discover and define their style. We reduce their anxiety and stress when getting ready in the morning. And, we give them time back in their lives to invest in themselves.

We do this through our unique business model that pairs expert Stylists with best-in-class artificial intelligence ("AI") and recommendation algorithms. It is this combination that enables us to help people discover the styles they will love without having to spend hours browsing stores or sifting through endless choices online.

Clients primarily engage with us by (1) receiving a curated shipment of items informed by our algorithms and chosen by a Stitch Fix Stylist (a "Fix"); or (2) purchasing directly from our website or mobile app based on an individualized assortment of outfit and item recommendations ("Freestyle"). Clients choose to schedule regular shipments or order a Fix on demand. Then, after receiving a Fix, they can purchase the items they want to keep and return the other items, if any.

Since our inception, Stitch Fix has been powered by AI and data science, and we continue to enhance these capabilities. Our rich data set and our proprietary algorithms fuel our business by enhancing the client experience and driving business model efficiencies. For example, we currently leverage AI and data science to match our Stylists to our clients and aid our Stylists in creating Fixes, help inform merchandise buying and inventory placement in our network, and optimize our approach to pricing and markdowns. Our large and growing data set provides the foundation for our proprietary algorithms. The vast majority of our client data is directly shared by the client, rather than inferred, scraped, or obtained from other sources. We also gather extensive trend data as well as merchandise data, such as inseam, pocket shape, silhouette, and fit. We believe that both the data we have, as well as our algorithms, give us a significant competitive advantage. As our data set has grown, our algorithms have become more powerful, and we expect that to continue.

Stitch Fix operates in the United States. When Stitch Fix first launched, we offered women's apparel. Since then, we have expanded our assortment to include Men's, Kids, Petite, Maternity, and Plus apparel, as well as shoes and accessories. We offer a wide selection of clothing and accessories across multiple price points and styles from our brand partners and our own private brands. Many of our brand partners also design and supply items exclusively for our clients.

At Stitch Fix, we build trusted and long-term relationships. We have delivered over 100 million Fixes, and, as of August 2, 2025, we had approximately 2,309,000 active clients. Refer to the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Key Financial and Operating Metrics" for information on how we define and calculate active clients.

When clients first sign up for Stitch Fix, they fill out an onboarding quiz through which they communicate their style, fit, and budget preferences. Then, to demonstrate to our clients that we "get" their style, at the end of the sign-up process, we present them with their StyleFile, a personalized snapshot that shares their individual style personality and the specific elements that contribute to it.
Once clients have onboarded, they can engage with us by receiving a Fix or by purchasing directly through Freestyle.

A Fix is a Stitch Fix-branded box containing a curated assortment of apparel, shoes, and accessories informed by our algorithms and chosen by Stitch Fix Stylists then delivered to the client to try on in the comfort of their own

home. Clients can keep some, all, or none of the items in the Fix and easily return any items in a prepaid-postage bag provided. In each Fix, a Stylist sends a client items from a broad range of merchandise recommended for the client by our algorithms. These algorithmic recommendations are based on the client's individual style preferences and order behavior, as well as the aggregate historical behavior of our client base, and the aggregate historical data we have collected on each item of merchandise we have available.
After onboarding to the service, clients choose their preferred order frequency and can select the exact date by which they want to receive their Fix. We currently offer two types of Fix scheduling:
•Auto-ship. Clients can elect to receive Fixes on a regular cadence aligned to their style needs.

Our business is subject to numerous risks. The following summary highlights some of the risks you should consider with respect to our business and prospects. This summary is not complete and the risks summarized below are not the only risks we face. You should review and consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described in more detail in the "Risk Factors" below, which includes a more complete discussion of the risks summarized here.

•We have in the past been and may in the future be unable to retain clients or maintain a high level of engagement with our clients and maintain or increase their spending with us, which has and could continue to harm our business, financial condition, or operating results.
•Our growth depends on attracting new clients.
•Risks associated with the sourcing and pricing of merchandise and raw materials, including those related to tariffs and shifting trade policies, could adversely affect our business.
•We rely on paid marketing to help grow our business, but these efforts may not be successful or cost effective, and such expenses and the success of our efforts may vary from period to period.
•If we are unable to manage our inventory effectively, our operating results could be adversely affected.

You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements", "Risk Factors" included under Part I, Item 1A, and our consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Annual Report").

We use a 52- or 53-week fiscal year, with our fiscal year ending on the Saturday that is closest to July 31 of that year. The fiscal year ending August 2, 2025 ("fiscal 2025") and July 29, 2023 ("fiscal 2023") consisted of 52 weeks, and the fiscal year ended August 3, 2024 ("fiscal 2024") consisted of 53 weeks. Throughout this Annual Report, all references to quarters and years are to our fiscal quarters and fiscal years unless otherwise noted.

In addition, refer to our discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2023 in Part II, Item 7 in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended August 3, 2024, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on September 25, 2024.

In 2011, Stitch Fix introduced an innovative approach to shopping for clothing and accessories. We were inspired by the opportunity to create a client-first styling experience, offering an alternative to impersonal, time-consuming and inconvenient traditional shopping. Clients primarily engage with us by (1) receiving a curated shipment of items informed by our algorithms and chosen by a Stitch Fix Stylist (a "Fix"); or (2) purchasing directly from our website or mobile app based on an individualized assortment of outfit and item recommendations ("Freestyle"). For the Fix experience, clients choose to schedule regular shipments or order a Fix on demand. Then, after receiving a Fix, they can purchase the items they want to keep and return the other items, if any.

During the first quarter of fiscal 2024, we ceased operations of our UK business and the accounting requirements for reporting the UK business as a discontinued operation were met. Accordingly, any discussion of historical information in Management's Discussion and Analysis below reflects the results of the UK business as a discontinued operation, and amounts and disclosures below relate to the Company's continuing operations for all periods presented, unless otherwise noted. Refer to Note 15, "Discontinued Operations" within the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report for further details.

For fiscal 2025, we reported $1.3 billion in revenue, net, representing a year-over-year decrease of 5.3%, compared to fiscal 2024. As of August 2, 2025, and August 3, 2024, we had approximately 2,309,000 and 2,508,000 active clients, respectively, representing a year-over-year decline of 7.9%.

During fiscal 2025, we experienced a decline in net revenue year-over-year primarily due to our challenges in acquiring and retaining active clients. In fiscal 2026, we expect broader macroeconomic uncertainty and market conditions to negatively impact consumer discretionary spending, and we will enter the fiscal year with fewer active clients than the start of fiscal 2025. However, we project that positive trends in average order values and the number of items kept per Fix will offset the negative impact of those active client losses on net revenue in fiscal 2026. We remain focused on retaining current clients, attracting new clients, improving the conversion of new visitors to our site and app, and enhancing our overall client experience for new and existing clients.
Net loss from continuing operations for fiscal 2025 was $28.8 million, compared to a net loss from continuing operations of $118.9 million for fiscal 2024.
For more information on the components of net loss from continuing operations for fiscal 2025, refer to the section titled "Results of Operations" below.
STITCH FIX, INC. | 2025 FORM 10-K | 33 RESTRUCTURING

During fiscal 2025, in furtherance of and as an expansion of the restructuring plan announced in June 2022 (the "2022 Restructuring Plan"), we recorded $1.2 million of additional restructuring charges. As of August 2, 2025, we do not expect any additional cash restructuring charges related to the 2022 Restructuring Plan.
Refer to Note 14, "Restructuring" within the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report for further details.

We are continuing to evaluate other fixed and variable operating costs, including further rationalizing our real estate footprint and continuing to optimize and be disciplined in our marketing strategy to better position ourselves for profitability. However, our future results of operations will depend on our ability to successfully navigate current business challenges and the overall macroeconomic environment.

Stitch Fix 是領先的線上個人搭配服務，幫助人們發現適合自己的風格，讓他們總是看起來 - 並感覺 - 最棒。
2011 年，Stitch Fix, Inc. ("we," "our," "us," "the Company," 或 "Stitch Fix") 推出了一種創新購物方式，用於服飾與配件。我們受到創造以客戶為中心的搭配體驗的啟發，提供一種與傳統耗時且不方便的購物方式不同的選擇。
自成立以來，我們的業務始終建立在對發展與培養客戶關係的承諾之上，並讓人們在穿著上更開心與自信。我們幫助客戶發現並定義他們的風格。我們減少他們早上準備時的壓力與焦慮。同時，我們也為他們節省時間，讓他們能投資於自己。
我們透過獨特的商業模式來實現這一點，該模式將專業搭配師與一流的人工智慧 ("AI") 與推薦演算法結合。這種組合使我們能夠幫助人們發現他們會喜愛的風格，而無需花費數小時在實體店內瀏覽，或在網路上篩選無數的選擇。
客戶主要透過以下兩種方式與我們互動：(1) 接收由我們演算法所篩選的物品，並由 Stitch Fix Stylist（簡稱 "Fix"）所選擇；或 (2) 根據我們提供的個別服裝與物品推薦清單，直接透過我們的網站或行動應用程式下單（簡稱 "Freestyle"）。客戶可選擇定期接收貨品或按需下單 Fix。在收到 Fix 後，客戶可購買其想保留的物品，並退回其他物品（如有）。

自我們成立以來，Stitch Fix 一直由 AI 與數據科學所驅動，我們持續提升這些能力。我們豐富的數據集與專利演算法，透過提升客戶體驗與提高商業模式效率，來推動業務。例如，我們目前運用 AI 與數據科學，將 Stylists 匹配至客戶，協助 Stylists 創建 Fix，協助決定商品採購與存貨配置，並優化我們的定價與折扣策略。我們龐大的數據集為我們的專利演算法奠定了基礎。我們的大多數客戶數據是直接由客戶提供，而非推論、爬取或來自其他來源。我們也收集廣泛的趨勢數據以及商品數據，例如褲管長度、口袋形狀、剪裁與合身程度。我們相信，我們所擁有的數據與演算法，為我們帶來顯著的競爭優勢。隨著數據集的增長，我們的演算法也變得更強大，我們預期這種趨勢會持續。
Stitch Fix 的營運範圍為美國。當 Stitch Fix 首次推出時，我們提供女性服飾。從那之後，我們已擴展商品種類，包括男裝、兒童裝、小碼、孕婦裝與加大碼服飾，以及鞋子與配件。我們提供來自品牌合作夥伴與自有品牌多種價格與風格的服裝與配件。許多品牌合作夥伴也為我們的客戶專門設計與供應商品。
在 Stitch Fix，我們致力於建立值得信賴且長遠的客戶關係。我們已送出超過 100 百萬個 Fix，截至 2025 年 8 月 2 日，我們約有 2,309,000 名活躍客戶。有關我們如何定義與計算活躍客戶的資訊，請參閱 "管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運成果—關鍵財務與營運指標" 節。
當客戶首次註冊 Stitch Fix 時，他們會填寫一份入門測試，透過此測試傳達他們的風格、合身度與預算偏好。然後，為讓客戶知道我們「瞭解」他們的風格，在註冊流程結束時，我們會為他們展示一份 StyleFile，這是一份個人化快照，分享他們的個人風格人格以及構成該風格的特定元素。
客戶完成入門流程後，可以透過接收 Fix 或直接透過 Freestyle 購買來與我們互動。
Fix 是一個 Stitch Fix 品牌的盒子，內含經過策劃的服裝、鞋類與配件，這些商品由我們的演算法所推薦，並由 Stitch Fix 的造型師選取，然後送達客戶家中試穿。
客戶可以保留部分、全部或完全不保留 Fix 中的物品，並可輕鬆透過預付郵資的袋子退回任何商品。在每個 Fix 中，造型師會為客戶從廣泛的商品中選取推薦商品，這些演算法推薦是根據客戶的個人風格偏好與訂購行為，以及我們客戶羣體的歷史行為總體數據，以及我們所擁有商品的歷史數據來進行的。
在完成入門流程後，客戶會選擇他們偏好的訂購頻率，並可選定他們希望收到 Fix 的確切日期。我們目前提供兩種 Fix 訂閱方式：
•Auto-ship。客戶可以選擇根據他們的風格需求，定期收到 Fix。

paragraphs: 你應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，並與「關於前瞻性陳述的特別提醒」、「風險因素」及包含於第一部分第 1A 項的內容，以及包含於第二部分第 8 項的年度財務報表及其相關附註一併參考。

我們採用 52 或 53 週的財務年度，財務年度結算日為該年 7 月 31 日最近的星期六。結算日為 2025 年 8 月 2 日（「財務 2025」）及 2023 年 7 月 29 日（「財務 2023」）的財務年度均為 52 週，結算日為 2024 年 8 月 3 日（「財務 2024」）的財務年度為 53 週。本年度報告中，所有提及季度及年度的參考均為我們的財務季度及財務年度，除非另有說明。
此外，請參閱我們在 2024 財務年度至 2023 財務年度的財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，包含於 2024 年 8 月 3 日結算的年度 10-K 報告，於 2024 年 9 月 25 日提交至證券交易委員會的內容，包含於第二部分第 7 項。

2011 年，Stitch Fix 引入了一種創新方式來購物服裝與配件。我們受到創造以客戶為中心的搭配體驗的機會啟發，提供一種與傳統購物方式相比，較為人性化、節省時間且更便利的選擇。客戶主要透過以下方式與我們互動：(1) 接收由我們的演算法所建議並由 Stitch Fix 組織師（「Fix」）所選取的精選商品組合；或 (2) 基於個別化的服裝與商品推薦，直接透過我們的網站或行動應用程式進行購物（「Freestyle」）。對於 Fix 經驗，客戶可選擇定期發送商品或按需訂購 Fix。在收到 Fix 後，客戶可以購買他們想保留的商品，並退回其他商品（如有）。
在 2024 財務年度的第一季，我們停止了英國業務的運作，並符合將英國業務作為已終止營運項目進行會計處理的條件。因此，管理層討論與分析中對歷史資訊的討論，反映英國業務作為已終止營運項目之結果，且以下的金額與揭露資訊均與本公司持續營運項目相關，除非另有說明。請參閱本年度報告第二部分第 8 項包含於合併財務報表附註中的「第 15 註：已終止營運項目」以取得更多細節。
2025 財務年度，我們報告的營業收入為 1.3 十億美元，較 2024 財務年度減少 5.3%。截至 2025 年 8 月 2 日及 2024 年 8 月 3 日，我們分別有約 2,309,000 與 2,508,000 名活躍客戶，分別較 2024 年減少 7.9%。

在 2025 財務年度，我們經歷了營業收入較去年同期下降，主要由於我們在獲取與留住活躍客戶方面遇到的挑戰。在 2026 財務年度，我們預期更廣泛的總體經濟不確定性與市場條件將對消費者非必需支出產生負面影響，且我們在 2026 財務年度開始時活躍客戶數將低於 2025 財務年度開始時的數量。然而，我們預期平均訂單價值的正面趨勢與每個 Fix 中保留商品數量的增加，將抵銷這些活躍客戶流失對 2026 財務年度營業收入的負面影響。我們持續專注於留住現有客戶、吸引新客戶、提高網站與應用程式新訪客的轉化率，並提升新舊客戶的整體體驗。
2025 財務年度持續營運業務的淨虧損為 28.8 百萬美元，較 2024 財務年度持續營運業務的淨虧損 118.9 百萬美元為少。
如需瞭解財務年度 2025 本公司持續營運之淨虧損成分，請參閱下述「營運成果」節。
STITCH FIX, INC. | 2025 年度 FORM 10-K | 33 重整
在財務年度 2025，為落實並擴展於 2022 年 6 月宣佈的重整計畫（「2022 重整計畫」），本公司計提額外 1.2 百萬美元之重整費用。截至 2025 年 8 月 2 日，本公司不預期與 2022 重整計畫相關之額外現金重整費用。
如需更多細節，請參閱本年度報告 Part II, Item 8 所包含之合併財務報表附註中的附註 14，標題為「重整」。
本公司持續評估其他固定及變動營運成本，包括進一步優化營業據點規模，並持續優化及嚴謹執行行銷策略，以更佳定位於獲利。然而，本公司未來營運成果將取決於本公司成功應對當前營運挑戰及總體經濟環境之能力。

本公司業務面臨許多風險。以下摘要說明部分應考慮的風險，但此摘要並非完整，下列總結的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。請詳閱並謹慎考慮下方「風險因素」中更詳細描述的風險與不確定性，其中包括對 herein 總結風險的更完整討論。
•過往本公司有時無法留住客戶或維持與客戶的高互動程度，並維持或增加其在本公司之支出，此情形已並可能繼續影響本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果。
•本公司成長取決於吸引新客戶。
•與商品及原材料來源與價格相關的風險，包括與關稅及貿易政策變動相關的風險，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
•本公司依賴付費行銷來協助業務成長，但這些行銷活動可能無法成功或具成本效益，且相關費用及行銷活動成效可能因期間而異。
•若本公司無法有效管理存貨，營運結果可能受到不利影響。
